The open mapping theorem and its twin, the **closed graph theorem**, imply each other; applying openness to bijections gives the inverse mapping theorem. Its most used corollary is the **equivalence of norms**: if two norms on the same linear space both make it a Banach space and one dominates the other, they are equivalent. Another meaning of the inverse theorem: in Banach spaces a continuous linear bijection is automatically a topological isomorphism — for linear homeomorphisms the continuity of the inverse need not be checked separately.

formulas.latex: X,Y\ \text{Banach},\quad T\in B(X,Y)\ \text{onto}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad T\ \text{is an open map}
formulas.note: 开映射定理：定义域与值域都完备、且 $T$ 满射——三者缺一不可；不要求单射。
formulas.noteEn: Open mapping theorem: both spaces Banach and $T$ onto — all three hypotheses are needed; injectivity is not required.

formulas.note: 开性的定量刻画（单位球的像包含原点附近的一个球）；对线性算子它与开映射完全等价。
formulas.noteEn: Quantitative form of openness (the image of the unit ball contains a ball around $0$); for linear maps it is equivalent to being open.

formulas.note: 逆算子定理：双射的连续线性算子，其逆自动连续（巴拿赫空间与线性是关键）。
formulas.noteEn: Inverse mapping theorem: the inverse of a bounded bijection is automatically bounded (Banach spaces and linearity are essential).

formulas.latex: T^{-1}\in B(Y,X)\iff \exists m>0:\quad \|Tx\|\ge m\|x\|\quad\forall x\in X
formulas.note: 逆有界的等价刻画（双射情形）：逆的连续性等价于 $T$ 有正下界 $m$；此时 $\|T^{-1}\|\le\frac1m$。
formulas.noteEn: Characterization of a bounded inverse (bijective case): continuity of $T^{-1}$ is equivalent to a positive lower bound $m$ for $T$, and then $\|T^{-1}\|\le\frac1m$.

formulas.latex: \|x\|_1\le C\|x\|_2\ \text{ and both norms complete}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad \|x\|_2\le C'\|x\|_1
formulas.note: 推论（范数等价定理）：两个完备范数若一方控制另一方，则彼此等价——对恒等映射用逆算子定理即得。
formulas.noteEn: Corollary (equivalence of norms): two complete norms, one dominating the other, are mutually equivalent — apply the inverse theorem to the identity map.

properties: 三个前提缺一不可：$X$ 完备、$Y$ 完备、$T$ 满射。不满射时结论失效：$Tf(x)=\int_0^xf$ 在 $C[0,1]$ 上有界单射，若它是开映射则 $T(B)$ 含原点邻域，任意 $y$ 都能按比例写成 $Tx$，$T$ 便满射，矛盾。
完备性不可省：例题 1 给出值域不完备时「连续双射的逆无界、开性失效」的构造（$\ell^1$ 配 $\ell^1$ 范数与 $\ell^2$ 范数）；去掉定义域的完备性，定理同样会失效——这正对应证明中两次使用完备性。
逆算子定理是开映射定理在双射情形的改写；开映射定理与闭图像定理可以互相推出，三者（连同一致有界原理）都以定义域空间完备为共同前提。
范数等价定理：同一空间上两个完备范数一方控制另一方则互相控制——这是逆算子定理最常用的非平凡推论。
对偶刻画（闭值域定理的初步面貌）：记 $T^*:Y^*\to X^*$，$T^*g=g\circ T$，则 $T^*$ 单射 $\iff$ $\operatorname{Im}T$ 在 $Y$ 中稠密；$T^*$ 满射 $\iff$ $T$ 单射且 $\operatorname{Im}T$ 闭。
propertiesEn: All three hypotheses are indispensable: $X$ complete, $Y$ complete, $T$ onto. Without surjectivity the conclusion fails: $Tf(x)=\int_0^xf$ is bounded and injective on $C[0,1]$; being open would force $T(B)$ to contain a ball about $0$, by scaling every $y$ would be some $Tx$, contradicting non-surjectivity.

Completeness cannot be dropped: Example 1 constructs a bounded bijection with unbounded inverse when the target is incomplete ($\ell^1$ with the $\ell^1$-norm versus the $\ell^2$-norm). Dropping completeness of the domain breaks the theorem as well — matching the two uses of completeness in the proof.

The inverse mapping theorem is the bijective case of openness; the open mapping and closed graph theorems imply each other, and all three (together with uniform boundedness) rest on completeness of the domain space.
Equivalence of norms: two complete norms on the same space, one dominating the other, are mutually equivalent — the most used non-trivial corollary of the inverse mapping theorem.

Dual description (first glimpse of the closed range theorem): for $T^*:Y^*\to X^*$, $T^*g=g\circ T$, one has $T^*$ injective $\iff$ $\operatorname{Im}T$ dense in $Y$, and $T^*$ surjective $\iff$ $T$ injective with $\operatorname{Im}T$ closed.

examples.problem: 设 $X=(\ell^1,\|\cdot\|_1)$，$Y=(\ell^1,\|\cdot\|_2)$（同一集合、不同范数），恒等映射 $T:X\to Y$，$Tx=x$。说明 $Y$ 不完备，$T$ 是有界双射，但 $T^{-1}$ 无界——逆算子定理的两条完备性假设确实必要。
examples.solution: $(\ell^1,\|\cdot\|_2)$ 是 $\ell^2$ 的稠密真子空间（$c_{00}\subset\ell^1$ 在 $\ell^2$ 中稠密，而 $(1/n)\in\ell^2\setminus\ell^1$），$\ell^2$ 完备故它不完备。$T$ 显然是双射，且 $\|Tx\|_2=\|x\|_2\le\|x\|_1$，故 $T\in B(X,Y)$。若 $T^{-1}$ 有界，即存在 $C$ 使 $\|x\|_1\le C\|x\|_2$ 对一切 $x\in\ell^1$ 成立；但取 $x^{(n)}=(1,1,\dots,1,0,\dots)/\sqrt n$（前 $n$ 项为 $1/\sqrt n$），则 $\|x^{(n)}\|_2=1$，而 $\|x^{(n)}\|_1=\sqrt n\to\infty$，矛盾。因此 $T^{-1}$ 无界、$T$ 不是开映射：值域完备性不可省。

examples.problem: 在 $\ell^2$ 上取有界数列 $(\lambda_n)$ 满足 $0<\inf_n|\lambda_n|$ 与 $\sup_n|\lambda_n|<\infty$，$T(x_n)=(\lambda_nx_n)$。验证 $T$ 是双射并求 $\|T^{-1}\|$；再说明若 $\lambda_n\to0$（如 $\lambda_n=1/n$）会发生什么。
examples.solution: $T$ 有界：$\|Tx\|_2\le(\sup_n|\lambda_n|)\|x\|_2$；因 $\inf_n|\lambda_n|>0$，对任意 $y\in\ell^2$ 取 $x_n=y_n/\lambda_n$，则 $\|x\|_2\le\frac1{\inf_n|\lambda_n|}\|y\|_2<\infty$，故 $T$ 满射；单射显然。由逆算子定理 $T^{-1}\in B(\ell^2)$，且 $T^{-1}(y_n)=(y_n/\lambda_n)$，$\|T^{-1}\|=\sup_n\frac1{|\lambda_n|}=\frac1{\inf_n|\lambda_n|}$。若 $\lambda_n\to0$，$T$ 仍单射但不满射（像稠密非闭），逆算子定理不适用；此时 $T^{-1}$（定义在像上）无界：取 $y^{(n)}=e_n$，$\|y^{(n)}\|_2=1$ 而 $T^{-1}y^{(n)}=e_n/\lambda_n$ 的范数为 $1/|\lambda_n|\to\infty$。

closed-graph.definition:
设 $X,Y$ 是赋范空间，乘积空间 $X\times Y$ 配范数 $\|(x,y)\|=\|x\|+\|y\|$（配 $\max$ 也可以，范数等价）；$X,Y$ 都是巴拿赫空间时 $X\times Y$ 也是。线性算子 $T:X\supseteq D(T)\to Y$ 的**图像**是子空间 $G(T)=\{(x,Tx):x\in D(T)\}\subseteq X\times Y$。$T$ 称为**闭算子**，若 $G(T)$ 在 $X\times Y$ 中闭；当 $D(T)=X$（处处定义）时，闭性等价于好用的序列判据：$x_n\to x$ 且 $Tx_n\to y$ 蕴含 $y=Tx$。

**闭图像定理**：设 $X,Y$ 都是**巴拿赫空间**，$T:X\to Y$ 是**处处定义的线性算子**（$D(T)=X$），且 $T$ 的图像在 $X\times Y$ 中**闭**，则 $T$ **有界**（因而连续）。请特别留意：定理的前提中**没有**假设 $T$ 有界——有界性是结论，这正是定理的威力：「图像闭」通常比「连续」容易验证，而定理把两者画上了等号。两个完备性与「处处定义」都不能少：连续线性算子显然有闭图像（容易方向），而只闭不连续的算子确实存在——它们只能定义在$X$ 的非闭真子空间（可以不稠密）上（如 $C[0,1]$ 或 $L^2$ 上的求导算子）。同一思想还可表述为：当 $X,Y$ 都是巴拿赫空间时，$T$ 闭当且仅当 $D(T)$ 配图像范数 $\|x\|_{G(T)}=\|x\|+\|Tx\|$ 是巴拿赫空间；于是闭算子无非是「配了图像范数的巴拿赫空间之间的有界算子」。

**一致有界原理（共鸣定理，Banach–Steinhaus）**：设 $X$ 是**巴拿赫空间**、$Y$ 是**赋范空间**（不必完备），$\{T_\alpha\}_{\alpha\in A}\subseteq B(X,Y)$ 是一族有界线性算子。若这族算子**逐点有界**，即对每个 $x\in X$ 有 $\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha x\|<\infty$，则它**一致有界**：$\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha\|<\infty$。证明仍用贝尔纲定理：从 $X=\bigcup_{m}\{x:\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha x\|\le m\}$ 中挑出一个含内点的闭集，再用线性性把内点放大到单位球。方向的要害是「逐点有界 $\Rightarrow$ 一致有界」；反向（一致有界 $\Rightarrow$ 逐点有界）由 $\|T_\alpha x\|\le\|T_\alpha\|\,\|x\|$ 显然成立，所以方向不能、也不需要反着用。两个假设也不可省：$X$ 不完备时结论可能失效（例如在 $c_{00}$ 上 $T_n(x)=nx_n$ 逐点有界但 $\|T_n\|=n$）；而 $Y$ 只需是赋范空间，这一点确实够用。

**常用推论**：若 $X$ 巴拿赫、$Y$ 赋范，$T_n\in B(X,Y)$ 且 $T_nx\to Tx$ 对每个 $x$ 成立，则极限算子 $T\in B(X,Y)$ 且 $\|T\|\le\liminf_n\|T_n\|\le\sup_n\|T_n\|<\infty$——逐点收敛的极限算子自动有界。逆否形式同样有力：若 $\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha\|=\infty$，则必存在 $x$ 使 $\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha x\|=\infty$。逐点收敛还能升级为**紧集上的一致收敛**。三个定理——开映射、闭图像、一致有界——都以**定义域空间完备**（贝尔纲定理）为基石：它们与哈恩-巴拿赫定理一起构成泛函分析的骨干，后者说的是「线性结构让延拓免费」，前者说的是「完备性让连续性免费」。
closed-graph.definitionEn:
Let $X,Y$ be normed spaces and give $X\times Y$ the norm $\|(x,y)\|=\|x\|+\|y\|$ (with $\max$ it is equivalent); $X\times Y$ is Banach when both $X,Y$ are. The **graph** of a linear operator $T:X\supseteq D(T)\to Y$ is the subspace $G(T)=\{(x,Tx):x\in D(T)\}\subseteq X\times Y$. $T$ is **closed** if $G(T)$ is closed in $X\times Y$; when $D(T)=X$ (everywhere defined) this is equivalent to the convenient sequential criterion: $x_n\to x$ and $Tx_n\to y$ imply $y=Tx$.

**Closed graph theorem**: let $X,Y$ be **Banach spaces** and $T:X\to Y$ **linear and everywhere defined** ($D(T)=X$). If the graph of $T$ is **closed** in $X\times Y$, then $T$ is **bounded** (hence continuous). Note carefully that the hypotheses **do not include** boundedness — boundedness is the conclusion, and that is the theorem's power: closedness of the graph is usually easier to check than continuity, yet the two coincide here. Neither completeness nor the everywhere-defined hypothesis can be dropped: continuous linear maps visibly have closed graphs (the easy direction), while closed but discontinuous operators do exist — they can only live on non-closed proper subspaces of $X$ (not necessarily dense) (e.g. differentiation on $C[0,1]$ or $L^2$). The same idea reads: when $X,Y$ are Banach, $T$ is closed if and only if $D(T)$ equipped with the graph norm $\|x\|_{G(T)}=\|x\|+\|Tx\|$ is a Banach space; a closed operator is thus nothing but a bounded operator between Banach spaces in disguise.

**Uniform boundedness principle (Banach–Steinhaus)**: let $X$ be a **Banach space**, $Y$ a **normed space** (not necessarily complete), and $\{T_\alpha\}_{\alpha\in A}\subseteq B(X,Y)$ a family of bounded operators. If the family is **pointwise bounded**, $\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha x\|<\infty$ for every $x\in X$, then it is **uniformly bounded**: $\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha\|<\infty$. The proof again uses Baire's theorem: extract from $X=\bigcup_m\{x:\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha x\|\le m\}$ a closed set with an interior point, then magnify that interior point to the unit ball by linearity. The essential direction is *pointwise bounded $\Rightarrow$ uniformly bounded*; the converse is trivial since $\|T_\alpha x\|\le\|T_\alpha\|\,\|x\|$, so the implication is never used backwards. Both hypotheses matter: the conclusion can fail when $X$ is incomplete (on $c_{00}$, $T_n(x)=nx_n$ is pointwise bounded yet $\|T_n\|=n$), whereas $Y$ really only needs to be normed.

**Standard corollary**: if $X$ is Banach, $Y$ normed, $T_n\in B(X,Y)$ and $T_nx\to Tx$ for every $x$, then $T\in B(X,Y)$ with $\|T\|\le\liminf_n\|T_n\|\le\sup_n\|T_n\|<\infty$ — pointwise limits of bounded operators are bounded. The contrapositive is equally powerful: $\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha\|=\infty$ forces the existence of some $x$ with $\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha x\|=\infty$. Pointwise convergence can even be upgraded to **uniform convergence on compact sets**. All three theorems — open mapping, closed graph, uniform boundedness — rest on **completeness of the domain space** (Baire); together with Hahn–Banach they form the backbone of functional analysis: the latter says linear structure makes extension free, the former say completeness makes continuity free.

formulas.note: 线性算子的图像是乘积空间的子空间；$T$ 闭即指 $G(T)$ 在 $X\times Y$ 中闭。
formulas.noteEn: The graph of a linear operator is a subspace of the product; $T$ is closed exactly when $G(T)$ is closed in $X\times Y$.

formulas.latex: G(T)\ \text{closed},\quad X,Y\ \text{Banach},\quad T\ \text{linear on all of } X\quad\Longrightarrow\quad T\in B(X,Y)
formulas.note: 闭图像定理：有界性是**结论**，不得先假设；定义域必须是完备的整个 $X$。
formulas.noteEn: Closed graph theorem: boundedness is the **conclusion**, never a hypothesis; the domain must be all of the Banach space $X$.

formulas.note: 处处定义算子的闭性序列判据；验证图像闭时用这一条最方便。
formulas.noteEn: Sequential criterion for closedness of an everywhere defined operator; the most convenient way to verify a closed graph.

formulas.note: 一致有界原理：只需 $X$ 巴拿赫、$Y$ 赋范；方向是「逐点有界 $\Rightarrow$ 一致有界」，反向平凡（一致有界当然逐点有界）。
formulas.noteEn: Uniform boundedness principle: only $X$ Banach and $Y$ normed are needed; the direction is pointwise bounded $\Rightarrow$ uniformly bounded (the converse is trivial).

formulas.note: 逐点收敛算子列的标准推论：极限有界，且范数不超过范数的下极限（从而 $\le\sup_n\|T_n\|<\infty$）。
formulas.noteEn: Standard corollary for pointwise convergent sequences: the limit is bounded with norm controlled by the lower limit of the norms (hence $\le\sup_n\|T_n\|<\infty$).

properties: 共同前提：开映射／逆算子／闭图像要求 $X,Y$ **都完备**，一致有界原理只要求**定义域 $X$ 完备**（$Y$ 赋范即可）；但三者都必须用贝尔纲定理，定义域完备是不可让的。
闭性弱于连续性（连续 $\Rightarrow$ 图像闭是容易方向）；在「$X,Y$ 巴拿赫 + 处处定义 + 线性」下两者等价。缺条件时差距可以很大：存在闭而无界的算子，但它们只能定义在$X$ 的非闭真子空间（可以不稠密）上。
一致有界原理的逆否形式极其有用：$\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha\|=\infty$ 时必存在「共鸣点」$x$ 使 $\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha x\|=\infty$；它使该定理成为「算子范数无界 $\Rightarrow$ 存在坏点」这类存在性结论的发动机。
熟悉的反例（$X$ 不完备时定理失效）：在 $c_{00}$（配 $\sup$ 范数）上 $T_n(x)=nx_n$ 逐点有界（有限支撑的 $x$ 最终为零）但 $\|T_n\|=n$；联系 Fourier 分析，部分和泛函的勒贝格常数 $L_N\sim\frac4{\pi^2}\ln N$ 无界，由逆否形式即得「存在连续函数其 Fourier 级数在一点发散」（见例题 2）。
闭图像定理与开映射定理互相等价，逆算子定理是开映射定理的双射特例；三者常与哈恩-巴拿赫并列为泛函分析基本定理——区别在于哈恩-巴拿赫不需要任何完备性。
propertiesEn: Common hypothesis: open mapping, inverse mapping and closed graph theorems need **both** $X,Y$ complete, while uniform boundedness needs only the **domain** $X$ complete ($Y$ normed is enough); all of them rely on Baire's theorem, so completeness of the domain is indispensable.

Closedness is weaker than continuity (continuous $\Rightarrow$ closed graph is the easy direction); under Banach spaces, everywhere defined and linear, the two coincide. Without the hypotheses the gap can be vast: closed unbounded operators exist, but only on non-closed proper subspaces of $X$ (not necessarily dense).

The contrapositive of uniform boundedness is extremely useful: $\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha\|=\infty$ forces some resonance point $x$ with $\sup_\alpha\|T_\alpha x\|=\infty$; this makes the theorem an engine of existence results (unbounded operator norms produce bad points).

A familiar counterexample (the theorem fails when $X$ is incomplete): on $c_{00}$ with the sup norm, $T_n(x)=nx_n$ is pointwise bounded (finitely supported $x$ eventually vanish) while $\|T_n\|=n$. In Fourier analysis the partial-sum functionals have Lebesgue constants $L_N\sim\frac4{\pi^2}\ln N$, so the contrapositive yields a continuous function whose Fourier series diverges at a point (Example 2).

The closed graph and open mapping theorems are equivalent, and the inverse mapping theorem is the bijective case of openness; the trio is usually listed with Hahn–Banach among the fundamental theorems of functional analysis — which, unlike the others, requires no completeness at all.

examples.problem: 取 $D(T)=C^1[0,1]\subset X=C[0,1]$（上确界范数），$T=\frac{d}{dx}:D(T)\to C[0,1]$。证明 $T$ 是闭算子但无界，并解释为何不违背闭图像定理。
examples.solution: (a) 闭性：若 $f_n\to f$ 且 $f_n'\to g$ 在 $C[0,1]$ 中（一致收敛），由微积分基本定理 $f_n(x)=f_n(0)+\int_0^xf_n'(t)\,dt$，令 $n\to\infty$ 得 $f(x)=f(0)+\int_0^xg(t)\,dt$，故 $f\in C^1$ 且 $f'=g$，即 $g=Tf$，图像闭。(b) 无界：取 $f_n(x)=\frac{\sin nx}{n}$，则 $\|f_n\|_\infty=\frac1n\to0$ 而 $\|Tf_n\|_\infty=\|\cos nx\|_\infty=1$，不存在 $C$ 使 $\|Tf\|\le C\|f\|$。(c) 不矛盾：$D(T)=C^1[0,1]\ne X$，且在 $X$ 中不完备——闭图像定理要求定义域是完备的整个空间，这里恰恰缺了「处处定义 + 定义域完备」，所以 $T$ 只能是定义在$X$ 的非闭真子空间（可以不稠密）上的无界闭算子。

examples.problem: 用一致有界原理证明：存在连续周期函数，其 Fourier 级数在某一点发散。
examples.solution: 在 $X=C[-\pi,\pi]$（上确界范数，巴拿赫空间）上定义泛函 $T_Nf=(S_Nf)(0)$（$f$ 的 Fourier 级数第 $N$ 部分和在 $0$ 点的值）。由于 $S_Nf(0)=\frac1{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}f(t)D_N(t)\,dt$（$D_N$ 为 Dirichlet 核），$\|T_N\|=L_N=\frac1{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}|D_N(t)|\,dt\sim\frac4{\pi^2}\ln N\to\infty$。若 $\{T_N\}$ 逐点有界，一致有界原理（$X$ 巴拿赫、$Y=\mathbb R$ 完备）将给出 $\sup_N\|T_N\|<\infty$，矛盾。故由逆否形式，存在 $f\in C[-\pi,\pi]$ 使 $\sup_N|(S_Nf)(0)|=\infty$，即 $f$ 的 Fourier 级数在 $0$ 点发散。这说明一致有界原理是「范数无界 $\Rightarrow$ 存在坏点」的存在性发动机。

compact-operators.definition:
设 $X,Y$ 是巴拿赫空间，$T\in B(X,Y)$。若 $T$ 把 $X$ 的每一个有界集都映成 $Y$ 中的**相对紧集**（像集的闭包是紧集），就称 $T$ 是**紧算子**，也称全连续算子。有一个完全等价的序列刻画，是做题时最常用的形式：$X$ 中任何有界序列 $\{x_n\}$ 都有子列 $\{x_{n_k}\}$，使 $\{Tx_{n_k}\}$ 在 $Y$ 中收敛。用单位球写出来，只要 $\overline{T(B_X)}$ 紧就够了——因为有界集都含于单位球的某个倍数中。

紧算子的直观是「无限维中的有限秩算子」：它把无穷多条独立方向的信息压进近乎有限维的像里。$\ell^2$ 上的对角算子 $T(x)=(\lambda_nx_n)$ 就是标准测试例：$T$ 紧当且仅当 $\lambda_n\to0$；而恒等算子对应 $\lambda_n\equiv1$，不紧。一般地，**恒等算子紧 $\iff$ 空间有限维**，这是判别紧性、也是间接判别「空间无限维」最常用的判据。

为什么要紧算子？因为它把有限维线性代数搬进了无限维：无限维空间中紧算子的谱由必然出现的 $0$ 与至多可数个特征值组成，特征值只能以 $0$ 为聚点，第二类弗雷德霍姆积分方程的解集结构与矩阵方程一模一样（见弗雷德霍姆二择一）。连续性核、平方可和核给出的积分算子都是紧算子，它们是泛函分析、积分方程与量子力学中最常见的一类「好算子」。
compact-operators.definitionEn:
Let $X,Y$ be Banach spaces and $T\in B(X,Y)$. Then $T$ is **compact** (also called completely continuous) if it maps every bounded subset of $X$ to a **relatively compact** subset of $Y$, that is, the closure of every image of a bounded set is compact. There is a fully equivalent sequential description, used in virtually every proof: every bounded sequence $\{x_n\}\subset X$ has a subsequence $\{x_{n_k}\}$ for which $\{Tx_{n_k}\}$ converges in $Y$. In terms of the closed unit ball it is enough that $\overline{T(B_X)}$ be compact, because every bounded set lies in some multiple of the unit ball.

The intuition is that a compact operator is ``a finite rank operator up to arbitrarily small error'': it crushes infinitely many independent directions into a nearly finite-dimensional image. The diagonal operator $T(x)=(\lambda_nx_n)$ on $\ell^2$ is the standard test case: it is compact exactly when $\lambda_n\to0$, while the identity operator corresponds to $\lambda_n\equiv1$ and is not compact. In general, **the identity is compact if and only if the space is finite-dimensional** — the most useful criterion both for compactness and, indirectly, for infinite-dimensionality.

Compact operators matter because they carry finite-dimensional linear algebra into infinite dimensions: on an infinite-dimensional space the spectrum of a compact operator consists of the inevitable point $0$ together with at most countably many eigenvalues, accumulating only at $0$, and the solution structure of Fredholm integral equations of the second kind is exactly that of matrix equations (see the Fredholm alternative). Integral operators with continuous or square-summable kernels are compact; they are the most common ``well-behaved'' operators in functional analysis, integral equations and quantum mechanics.

formulas.note: 定义的单位球版本：$B_X$ 是 $X$ 的闭单位球。只要单位球像的闭包紧，由齐次性与线性性，一切有界集的像都相对紧。
formulas.noteEn: The unit-ball form of the definition: $B_X$ is the closed unit ball of $X$. Once the closure of the image of the unit ball is compact, homogeneity and linearity make the image of every bounded set relatively compact.

formulas.note: 序列刻画。它是证明紧性时最常用的入口，也是证明「不紧」的常用出口：找一个有界序列，其像的任何子列都不收敛（如标准正交基）。
formulas.noteEn: The sequential characterisation: the usual entry point for proving compactness, and the usual exit for disproving it — exhibit a bounded sequence whose image has no convergent subsequence (e.g. an orthonormal basis).

formulas.note: 紧算子在算子范数下封闭：紧算子全体 $\mathcal K(X,Y)$ 是 $B(X,Y)$ 的闭子空间，因此「有限秩算子的一致极限」自动紧，这是构造紧算子最常用的办法。
formulas.noteEn: Compact operators are closed in the operator norm: the set $\mathcal K(X,Y)$ is a closed subspace of $B(X,Y)$, so uniform limits of finite rank operators are compact — the standard way to construct compact operators.

formulas.latex: T\ \text{紧},\ S\ \text{有界}\ \Longrightarrow\ ST\ \text{与}\ TS\ \text{紧}
formulas.note: 紧算子与有界算子复合仍紧：$\mathcal K(X)$ 是 $B(X)$ 的闭双边理想。特别地，$T$ 紧则 $T^n$ 紧。
formulas.noteEn: Composing a compact operator with bounded operators stays compact: $\mathcal K(X)$ is a closed two-sided ideal of $B(X)$. In particular $T$ compact implies $T^n$ compact.

formulas.note: 无限维空间上恒等算子不紧：取标准正交基，$\|e_m-e_n\|=\sqrt2$，像序列没有收敛子列。这是最常用的非紧性判据。
formulas.noteEn: The identity on an infinite-dimensional space is not compact: for an orthonormal basis, $\|e_m-e_n\|=\sqrt2$, so no subsequence of the image converges. This is the standard non-compactness criterion.

properties: 有限秩算子（值域有限维）必紧；紧算子全体 $\mathcal K(X,Y)$ 是 $B(X,Y)$ 的闭子空间，故有限秩算子的一致极限必紧。
紧算子与有界算子复合仍紧（$\mathcal K(X)$ 是 $B(X)$ 的闭双边理想）；特别地 $T$ 紧则 $T^n$ 紧。
恒等算子紧当且仅当空间有限维；无限维空间上恒等算子不紧，这是判定算子非紧的标准入口。
紧算子把弱收敛升级为范数收敛：$x_n\rightharpoonup x\Rightarrow Tx_n\to Tx$；从而紧算子的值域是可分的。
（Schauder 定理）$T\in B(X,Y)$ 紧当且仅当其伴随 $T^*\in B(Y^*,X^*)$ 紧。
propertiesEn: Every finite rank operator (finite-dimensional range) is compact; the set $\mathcal K(X,Y)$ of compact operators is a closed subspace of $B(X,Y)$, so uniform limits of finite rank operators are compact.
Composing a compact operator with bounded operators stays compact ($\mathcal K(X)$ is a closed two-sided ideal of $B(X)$); in particular $T$ compact implies $T^n$ compact.
The identity is compact iff the space is finite-dimensional; on an infinite-dimensional space the identity is not compact — the standard first step in showing that an operator fails to be compact.
A compact operator upgrades weak convergence to norm convergence: $x_n\rightharpoonup x\Rightarrow Tx_n\to Tx$; consequently the range of a compact operator is separable.
(Schauder) $T\in B(X,Y)$ is compact iff its adjoint $T^*\in B(Y^*,X^*)$ is compact.

examples.problem: 在 $\ell^2$ 上定义对角算子 $T(x_1,x_2,\dots)=(\lambda_1x_1,\lambda_2x_2,\dots)$，其中 $(\lambda_n)$ 有界。证明：若 $\lambda_n\to0$ 则 $T$ 紧；并用 $e_n$ 说明若沿无穷子列 $|\lambda_n|\ge c>0$，则 $T$ 不紧。
examples.solution:
令 $T_N(x)=(\lambda_1x_1,\dots,\lambda_Nx_N,0,\dots)$。$T_N$ 值域至多 $N$ 维，是有限秩算子，从而紧。并且
$$\|T-T_N\|=\sup_{n>N}|\lambda_n|\to0\qquad(N\to\infty),$$
紧算子全体是闭子空间，故 $T$ 作为紧算子的一致极限仍紧。反之设 $|\lambda_{n_k}|\ge c>0$，考虑有界序列 $\{e_{n_k}\}$：对 $k\ne j$，
$$\|Te_{n_k}-Te_{n_j}\|=\|\lambda_{n_k}e_{n_k}-\lambda_{n_j}e_{n_j}\|=\sqrt{|\lambda_{n_k}|^2+|\lambda_{n_j}|^2}\ge\sqrt2\,c,$$
任何子列都不是柯西列，故 $T$ 不紧。综合得：对角算子 $T$ 紧 $\iff$ $\lambda_n\to0$。

examples.problem: 用标准正交基说明：无限维希尔伯特空间上的恒等算子不紧。
examples.solution:
取标准正交基 $\{e_n\}$，则 $\|e_n\|=1$ 是有界序列。对任意 $m\ne n$，
$$\|Ie_m-Ie_n\|=\|e_m-e_n\|=\sqrt2.$$
若恒等算子紧，则存在子列 $\{e_{n_k}\}$ 使 $\{Ie_{n_k}\}=\{e_{n_k}\}$ 收敛；但该子列中任意两项的距离恒为 $\sqrt2$，不可能是柯西列，矛盾。故恒等算子不紧——由「恒等算子紧 $\iff$ 空间有限维」，无限维空间上的恒等算子永远不紧。

expression.text: T ∈ B(X,Y) 紧 ⟺ T 把 X 的每个有界集映成 Y 的相对紧集；B_X 为 X 的闭单位球
expression.note: 记号：$\mathcal K(X,Y)$ 表示 $B(X,Y)$ 中的紧算子全体；$B_X$ 是闭单位球。
expression.noteEn: Notation: $\mathcal K(X,Y)$ denotes the compact operators inside $B(X,Y)$; $B_X$ is the closed unit ball.

spectrum.definition:
设 $X$ 是复巴拿赫空间，$T\in B(X)$。若 $\lambda I-T$ 在 $B(X)$ 中可逆，即存在有界逆算子 $(\lambda I-T)^{-1}\in B(X)$，就称 $\lambda$ 属于 $T$ 的**预解集** $\rho(T)$，而 $R(\lambda,T)=(\lambda I-T)^{-1}$ 称为 $T$ 在 $\lambda$ 处的**预解算子**。不属于预解集的复数就是**谱点**：
$$\sigma(T)=\{\lambda\in\mathbb C:\lambda I-T\ \text{不可逆}\},\qquad \rho(T)=\mathbb C\setminus\sigma(T).$$
「可逆」是对算子所在的巴拿赫空间说的：同一个公式作用在别的空间上可能变得可逆，谱因此依赖空间。在巴拿赫空间里，由开映射定理（有界逆定理），$\lambda I-T$ 可逆等价于它是有界双射，所以检验谱点时「单射」或「满射」任何一条失效都算数。

在有限维空间里，$\lambda I-T$ 可逆 $\iff$ $\det(\lambda I-T)\ne0$ $\iff$ $\lambda$ 是特征值，所以谱就是特征值集合，且必非空（代数基本定理）。无限维的谱比特征值大得多，按 $\lambda I-T$ 失效的方式分成三类：**点谱** $\sigma_p(T)$（特征值：$(\lambda I-T)x=0$ 有非零解）、**连续谱** $\sigma_c(T)$（$\lambda I-T$ 单射、值域稠密但不等于 $X$）、**剩余谱** $\sigma_r(T)$（其余情形：单射但值域不稠密）。三者两两不交、并为 $\sigma(T)$。方向必须记牢：**特征值一定属于谱**（不可逆最粗暴的一种失效），**但谱点未必是特征值**。乘法算子 $(Mx)(t)=tx(t)$ 在 $L^2[0,1]$ 上给出标准例子：$\sigma(M)=[0,1]$，而 $(t-\lambda)x(t)=0$ 几乎处处推出 $x=0$，故它没有特征值，整条谱都是连续谱。

谱有多大？**谱半径** $r(T)=\sup_{\lambda\in\sigma(T)}|\lambda|$ 由 Gelfand 的**谱半径公式** $r(T)=\lim_{n\to\infty}\|T^n\|^{1/n}$ 计算，特别地 $r(T)\le\|T\|$，非正规算子上等号可能取不到。谱在哪里？当 $|\lambda|>\|T\|$ 时 $\lambda I-T=\lambda(I-T/\lambda)$ 按 Neumann 级数可逆，所以 $\sigma(T)$ 含于闭圆盘 $\{|\lambda|\le\|T\|\}$；由 $\rho(T)$ 开知 $\sigma(T)$ 闭，于是**谱是紧集**。最后，若 $X$ 是**复**巴拿赫空间则 $\sigma(T)\ne\varnothing$：否则预解算子在整条 $\mathbb C$ 上解析、在无穷远处趋于零因而有界，由 Liouville 定理只能恒为零，矛盾（$R(\lambda,T)$ 是可逆算子，不为零）。实空间上谱却可能空无一点，例如平面旋转 $90^\circ$ 的矩阵在 $\mathbb R^2$ 上没有实特征值。
spectrum.definitionEn:
Let $X$ be a complex Banach space and $T\in B(X)$. If $\lambda I-T$ is invertible in $B(X)$, that is, a bounded inverse $(\lambda I-T)^{-1}\in B(X)$ exists, then $\lambda$ lies in the **resolvent set** $\rho(T)$ and $R(\lambda,T)=(\lambda I-T)^{-1}$ is called the **resolvent** of $T$ at $\lambda$. The remaining complex numbers form the **spectrum**: $\sigma(T)=\{\lambda\in\mathbb C:\lambda I-T\ \text{is not invertible}\}$ and $\rho(T)=\mathbb C\setminus\sigma(T)$. ``Invertible'' is meant with respect to the Banach space on which the operator acts: the same formula may become invertible on another space, so the spectrum depends on the space. In a Banach space the bounded inverse theorem (a corollary of the open mapping theorem) says that $\lambda I-T$ is invertible iff it is a bounded bijection, so a failure of injectivity or of surjectivity already produces a spectral point.

In finite dimensions $\lambda I-T$ is invertible iff $\det(\lambda I-T)\ne0$ iff $\lambda$ is an eigenvalue, so the spectrum is exactly the set of eigenvalues and is nonempty by the fundamental theorem of algebra. In infinite dimensions the spectrum is much larger than the point spectrum and is classified by the way $\lambda I-T$ fails: the **point spectrum** $\sigma_p(T)$ (eigenvalues, $\ker(\lambda I-T)\ne\{0\}$), the **continuous spectrum** $\sigma_c(T)$ ($\lambda I-T$ injective, with dense range different from $X$) and the **residual spectrum** $\sigma_r(T)$ (the rest: injective with non-dense range). These three sets are disjoint and their union is $\sigma(T)$. Keep the direction straight: **every eigenvalue belongs to the spectrum** — non-injectivity is the crudest possible failure — **but a spectral point need not be an eigenvalue.** The multiplication operator $(Mx)(t)=tx(t)$ on $L^2[0,1]$ is the standard example: $\sigma(M)=[0,1]$, while $(t-\lambda)x(t)=0$ almost everywhere forces $x=0$, so $M$ has no eigenvalues and its whole spectrum is continuous.

How large is the spectrum? Its **spectral radius** $r(T)=\sup_{\lambda\in\sigma(T)}|\lambda|$ is computed by Gelfand's **spectral radius formula** $r(T)=\lim_{n\to\infty}\|T^n\|^{1/n}$; in particular $r(T)\le\|T\|$, and for non-normal operators equality may fail. Where does it sit? For $|\lambda|>\|T\|$ the Neumann series makes $\lambda I-T=\lambda(I-T/\lambda)$ invertible, so $\sigma(T)$ lies in the closed disc $\{|\lambda|\le\|T\|\}$; since $\rho(T)$ is open, $\sigma(T)$ is closed, hence **compact**. Finally, if $X$ is a **complex** Banach space then $\sigma(T)\ne\varnothing$: otherwise the resolvent would be analytic on all of $\mathbb C$, bounded (it tends to $0$ at infinity), and nowhere zero, contradicting Liouville's theorem. Over a real Banach space the spectrum can be empty — the matrix of a $90^\circ$ rotation has no real eigenvalue.

formulas.note: 谱与预解集的定义：$\lambda I-T$ 在 $B(X)$ 中存在有界逆。$R(\lambda,T)=(\lambda I-T)^{-1}$ 称为预解算子。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of spectrum and resolvent set: $\lambda I-T$ has a bounded inverse in $B(X)$. The operator $R(\lambda,T)=(\lambda I-T)^{-1}$ is the resolvent.

formulas.note: 有界逆定理（开映射定理的推论）：巴拿赫空间上单射满射的有界算子必有有界逆，所以验证可逆性只需验证双射。
formulas.noteEn: Bounded inverse theorem (a corollary of the open mapping theorem): a bounded bijection between Banach spaces has a bounded inverse, so invertibility need only be checked as a bijection.

formulas.note: $|\lambda|>\|T\|$ 时用 Neumann 级数 $R(\lambda,T)=\sum_{n\ge0}T^n/\lambda^{n+1}$ 求逆；由此谱有界，又谱闭，故紧。
formulas.noteEn: For $|\lambda|>\|T\|$ the Neumann series gives $R(\lambda,T)=\sum_{n\ge0}T^n/\lambda^{n+1}$; the spectrum is bounded and closed, hence compact.

formulas.note: Gelfand 谱半径公式：极限恒存在，且等于下确界。自伴（更一般地正规）算子满足 $r(T)=\|T\|$。
formulas.noteEn: Gelfand's spectral radius formula: the limit always exists and equals the infimum. For self-adjoint (more generally normal) operators $r(T)=\|T\|$.

formulas.note: 谱的划分：点谱（特征值）、连续谱、剩余谱。特征值必在谱中，但谱点可以是连续谱或剩余谱而非特征值。
formulas.noteEn: Classification of the spectrum: point spectrum (eigenvalues), continuous spectrum, residual spectrum. Eigenvalues are always spectral points, but a spectral point can be continuous or residual rather than an eigenvalue.

properties: 谱是紧集且含于闭圆盘 $\{|\lambda|\le\|T\|\}$；$|\lambda|>\|T\|$ 时 $\lambda\in\rho(T)$，且 $R(\lambda,T)=\sum_{n\ge0}T^n/\lambda^{n+1}$。
$\rho(T)$ 是开集，预解算子在其上解析，并满足第一预解等式 $R(\lambda,T)-R(\mu,T)=-(\lambda-\mu)R(\lambda,T)R(\mu,T)$；复巴拿赫空间上 $\sigma(T)\ne\varnothing$（Liouville），实空间上可以为空。
特征值必属于谱，但谱点不必是特征值；谱分成点谱、连续谱、剩余谱的不交并。例：$L^2[0,1]$ 上 $(Mx)(t)=tx(t)$ 的谱为 $[0,1]=\sigma_c(M)$，没有特征值。
谱半径公式 $r(T)=\lim_{n\to\infty}\|T^n\|^{1/n}=\inf_{n\ge1}\|T^n\|^{1/n}$，且 $r(T)\le\|T\|$；自伴（更一般地正规）算子有 $r(T)=\|T\|$。
谱在相似变换下不变：$\sigma(S^{-1}TS)=\sigma(T)$；$T$ 可逆当且仅当 $0\notin\sigma(T)$；有限维时 $\sigma(T)$ 恰是特征值全体，由 $\det(\lambda I-T)=0$ 给出。
propertiesEn: The spectrum is compact and lies in the closed disc $\{|\lambda|\le\|T\|\}$; for $|\lambda|>\|T\|$ one has $\lambda\in\rho(T)$ with $R(\lambda,T)=\sum_{n\ge0}T^n/\lambda^{n+1}$.

$\rho(T)$ is open and the resolvent is analytic there, satisfying the first resolvent identity $R(\lambda,T)-R(\mu,T)=-(\lambda-\mu)R(\lambda,T)R(\mu,T)$; on a complex Banach space $\sigma(T)\ne\varnothing$ (Liouville), while over $\mathbb R$ it can be empty.

Eigenvalues always belong to the spectrum, but spectral points need not be eigenvalues; the spectrum is the disjoint union of point, continuous and residual spectrum. Example: $(Mx)(t)=tx(t)$ on $L^2[0,1]$ has spectrum $[0,1]=\sigma_c(M)$ and no eigenvalues.
Spectral radius formula: $r(T)=\lim_{n\to\infty}\|T^n\|^{1/n}=\inf_{n\ge1}\|T^n\|^{1/n}$, and $r(T)\le\|T\|$; for self-adjoint (more generally normal) operators $r(T)=\|T\|$.

The spectrum is invariant under similarity, $\sigma(S^{-1}TS)=\sigma(T)$; $T$ is invertible iff $0\notin\sigma(T)$; in finite dimensions $\sigma(T)$ is exactly the set of eigenvalues, given by $\det(\lambda I-T)=0$.

examples.problem: 设 $T$ 是 $\ell^2$ 上的对角算子 $T=\operatorname{diag}(1,\tfrac12,\tfrac13,\dots)$。求 $\sigma(T)$ 与 $\sigma_p(T)$，并指出哪些谱点不是特征值。
examples.solution:
$((\lambda I-T)x)_n=(\lambda-\frac1n)x_n$。$\lambda I-T$ 可逆当且仅当其系数列有正下界，即 $\inf_n|\lambda-\frac1n|>0$，这等价于 $\lambda\notin\{0\}\cup\{\frac1n:n\ge1\}$。因此
$$\sigma(T)=\{0\}\cup\{1/n:n\ge1\}$$
（注：由谱闭也可直接看出 $0$ 必须补进去，它是特征值集合的唯一聚点）。每个 $1/n$ 都是特征值：$Te_n=\frac1ne_n$，故 $\sigma_p(T)=\{1/n:n\ge1\}$。而 $0\notin\sigma_p(T)$：$Tx=0$ 迫使 $x_n=0$ 对所有 $n$ 成立，即 $T$ 单射；但 $T$ 不满射——解 $Tx=y$ 需要 $x_n=ny_n$ 平方可和，例如 $y=(1/n)$ 就不在值域之中（$\sum n^2\cdot\frac1{n^2}=\infty$），故 $T$ 不可逆。于是 $0\in\sigma(T)\setminus\sigma_p(T)$，且值域稠密（含所有有限支撑向量），所以 $0$ 属于连续谱：这正说明「谱点未必是特征值」。

examples.problem: 对 $T=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ 计算 $r(T)$ 与 $\|T\|$，并验证谱半径公式。
examples.solution:
$T$ 是上三角矩阵，特征多项式为 $(\lambda-1)^2$，故 $\sigma(T)=\{1\}$，$r(T)=1$。而 $\|T\|$ 等于最大奇异值：$T^*T=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$，其特征值为 $\frac{3\pm\sqrt5}{2}$，故
$$\|T\|=\sqrt{\frac{3+\sqrt5}{2}}=\frac{1+\sqrt5}{2}\approx1.618>1=r(T),$$
说明 $r(T)<\|T\|$ 完全可以发生（非正规算子）。另一方面 $T^n=\begin{pmatrix}1&n\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$，其最大奇异值为 $\frac{n+\sqrt{n^2+4}}{2}$，于是
$$\|T^n\|^{1/n}=\left(\frac{n+\sqrt{n^2+4}}{2}\right)^{1/n}\to1=r(T),$$
谱半径公式得到验证。

expression.text: σ(T) = {λ ∈ ℂ : λI−T 不可逆}；ρ(T) = ℂ∖σ(T)；R(λ,T) = (λI−T)⁻¹；r(T) = lim_{n→∞} ‖Tⁿ‖^(1/n)
expression.note: 复巴拿赫空间上谱非空，且是含于 $\{|\lambda|\le\|T\|\}$ 的紧集；谱半径 $r(T)\le\|T\|$。
expression.noteEn: Over a complex Banach space the spectrum is nonempty and compact, contained in $\{|\lambda|\le\|T\|\}$; the spectral radius satisfies $r(T)\le\|T\|$.

spectral-theorem.definition:
设 $H$ 是希尔伯特空间，$T\in B(H)$。若 $T$ 等于它的伴随算子：$T=T^*$，即
$$\langle Tx,y\rangle=\langle x,Ty\rangle,\qquad \forall x,y\in H,$$
则称 $T$ 是**自伴算子**。这是「实对称矩阵」在无限维的推广，两个基本结论是：二次型取实值，$\langle Tx,x\rangle\in\mathbb R$；并且**自伴算子的谱含于实轴**。同时范数与谱之间不再有间隙——对自伴（更一般地，正规）算子有
$$\|T\|=\sup_{\lambda\in\sigma(T)}|\lambda|=r(T),$$
而一般算子只满足 $r(T)\le\|T\|$（$2\times2$ 的非正规 Jordan 块就是严格小于的例子）。还有一条自伴算子特有的「二次型范数」等式：$\|T\|=\sup_{\|x\|=1}|\langle Tx,x\rangle|$。

**紧自伴算子的谱定理**（希尔伯特—施密特定理的算子形式）：设 $H$ 是可分希尔伯特空间，$T$ 紧且自伴，则存在由 $T$ 的特征向量组成的**标准正交基** $\{e_k\}$，对应特征值 $\lambda_k$ 全为实数；非零特征值至多可数，每个非零特征值的特征子空间有限维，并且非零特征值只能以 $0$ 为聚点。换句话说，$\sigma(T)$ 中除可能的 $0$ 之外全部是特征值。按这组基把算子写开：
$$Tx=\sum_k\lambda_k\langle x,e_k\rangle e_k,$$
形式上与对称矩阵的谱分解 $T=\sum_k\lambda_kP_k$（$P_k$ 为到特征子空间的正交投影）完全相同；特别地 $\|T\|=\max_k|\lambda_k|$。

当 $H$ 不可分或 $T$ 不紧时，一般自伴算子仍有谱定理，只是把「特征值展开」换成**投影值测度**（谱测度）$E$：$T=\int_{\sigma(T)}\lambda\,dE(\lambda)$；在可分希尔伯特空间上，这等价于说 $T$ 酉等价于某个「乘实函数的乘法算子」。紧自伴情形之所以重要，正是因为它把抽象的谱定理退化回最熟悉的矩阵对角化，是积分算子理论与 Sturm–Liouville 问题的核心工具。
spectral-theorem.definitionEn:
Let $H$ be a Hilbert space and $T\in B(H)$. Then $T$ is **self-adjoint** if it equals its adjoint, $T=T^*$, that is, $\langle Tx,y\rangle=\langle x,Ty\rangle$ for all $x,y\in H$. This is the infinite-dimensional version of a real symmetric matrix, and two facts are basic: the quadratic form is real, $\langle Tx,x\rangle\in\mathbb R$, and **the spectrum of a self-adjoint operator lies on the real axis**. Moreover the gap between norm and spectrum closes: for self-adjoint (more generally normal) operators $\|T\|=\sup_{\lambda\in\sigma(T)}|\lambda|=r(T)$, whereas a general operator only satisfies $r(T)\le\|T\|$ (a $2\times2$ non-normal Jordan block is a strict example). A further identity peculiar to self-adjoint operators is the ``quadratic form norm'' $\|T\|=\sup_{\|x\|=1}|\langle Tx,x\rangle|$.

**The spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators** (the operator form of the Hilbert–Schmidt theorem): let $H$ be a separable Hilbert space and let $T$ be compact and self-adjoint. Then $H$ has an **orthonormal basis** $\{e_k\}$ consisting of eigenvectors of $T$, with all eigenvalues $\lambda_k$ real; the nonzero eigenvalues are at most countably many, each nonzero eigenspace is finite-dimensional, and the nonzero eigenvalues can accumulate only at $0$. In other words, every point of $\sigma(T)$ except possibly $0$ is an eigenvalue. Expanding along this basis, $Tx=\sum_k\lambda_k\langle x,e_k\rangle e_k$, formally identical with the spectral decomposition $T=\sum_k\lambda_kP_k$ of a symmetric matrix ($P_k$ the orthogonal projection onto the eigenspace); in particular $\|T\|=\max_k|\lambda_k|$.

When $H$ is non-separable or $T$ is not compact, the general self-adjoint spectral theorem replaces the eigenvalue expansion by a **projection-valued measure** (spectral measure) $E$: $T=\int_{\sigma(T)}\lambda\,dE(\lambda)$; on a separable Hilbert space this says that $T$ is unitarily equivalent to multiplication by a real function. The compact self-adjoint case matters precisely because it reduces the abstract theorem to the familiar diagonalisation of a matrix; it is the central tool in the theory of integral operators and Sturm–Liouville problems.

formulas.note: 自伴的定义：$T$ 与伴随算子相等。等价地，二次型 $\langle Tx,x\rangle$ 对一切 $x$ 取实值。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of self-adjointness: $T$ equals its adjoint. Equivalently, the quadratic form $\langle Tx,x\rangle$ is real for every $x$.

formulas.note: 自伴算子的谱在实轴上，且范数等于谱半径（自伴算子是正规算子：$T^*T=TT^*$）。
formulas.noteEn: A self-adjoint operator has real spectrum, and its norm equals its spectral radius (self-adjoint operators are normal: $T^*T=TT^*$).

formulas.latex: T\ \text{紧自伴}\ \Longrightarrow\ \exists\,\{e_k\}\ \text{标准正交基}:\quad Te_k=\lambda_k e_k,\quad \lambda_k\in\mathbb R,\quad H=\overline{\operatorname{span}}\{e_k\}
formulas.note: 紧自伴算子的谱定理（希尔伯特—施密特）：特征向量构成标准正交基，特征值全为实数。
formulas.noteEn: Spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators (Hilbert–Schmidt): the eigenvectors form an orthonormal basis and the eigenvalues are all real.

formulas.note: 按特征基展开，与对称矩阵的对角化完全同形（级数在范数意义下收敛）。
formulas.noteEn: Expansion along the eigenbasis, exactly as for the diagonalisation of a symmetric matrix (the series converges in norm).

formulas.note: 非零特征值至多可数、只能以 $0$ 为聚点，且每个非零特征子空间有限维；$0$ 本身可以不是特征值（如 $\operatorname{diag}(1/n)$）。
formulas.noteEn: The nonzero eigenvalues are at most countable, can accumulate only at $0$, and each nonzero eigenspace is finite-dimensional; $0$ itself need not be an eigenvalue (e.g. $\operatorname{diag}(1/n)$).

properties: 自伴算子的特征值全为实数：若 $Tx=\lambda x$（$x\ne0$），则 $\lambda\|x\|^2=\langle Tx,x\rangle=\overline{\langle x,Tx\rangle}=\bar\lambda\|x\|^2$；不同特征值的特征向量相互正交。
自伴算子的谱含于实轴，且 $\|T\|=\sup_{\lambda\in\sigma(T)}|\lambda|=r(T)$；此外 $m=\inf_{\|x\|=1}\langle Tx,x\rangle$ 与 $M=\sup_{\|x\|=1}\langle Tx,x\rangle$ 都属于 $\sigma(T)$，且 $\sigma(T)\subseteq[m,M]$。
紧自伴算子的谱定理：存在特征向量的标准正交基；非零特征值至多可数、特征子空间有限维、只能以 $0$ 为聚点。$0$ 可以不成为特征值（如 $\operatorname{diag}(1/n)$，此时 $0\in\sigma_c(T)$）。
紧性不能去掉：乘法算子 $(Mx)(t)=tx(t)$ 在 $L^2[0,1]$ 上自伴但不紧，谱为 $[0,1]$ 且没有特征向量；一般自伴算子用投影值测度表达：$T=\int\lambda\,dE(\lambda)$。
常见应用：正算子（$\langle Tx,x\rangle\ge0$）的谱非负，可开平方 $\sqrt T$；把特征值按绝对值排序 $|\lambda_1|\ge|\lambda_2|\ge\cdots$ 后 $\|T\|=|\lambda_1|$，这是积分算子、Sturm–Liouville 问题的标准工具。
propertiesEn: Eigenvalues of a self-adjoint operator are real: if $Tx=\lambda x$ with $x\ne0$, then $\lambda\|x\|^2=\langle Tx,x\rangle=\overline{\langle x,Tx\rangle}=\bar\lambda\|x\|^2$; eigenvectors of distinct eigenvalues are orthogonal.

The spectrum of a self-adjoint operator is real and $\|T\|=\sup_{\lambda\in\sigma(T)}|\lambda|=r(T)$; moreover both $m=\inf_{\|x\|=1}\langle Tx,x\rangle$ and $M=\sup_{\|x\|=1}\langle Tx,x\rangle$ belong to $\sigma(T)$, and $\sigma(T)\subseteq[m,M]$.

Spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators: an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors exists; the nonzero eigenvalues are at most countable, their eigenspaces finite-dimensional, and they can accumulate only at $0$. The point $0$ need not be an eigenvalue (e.g. $\operatorname{diag}(1/n)$, where $0\in\sigma_c(T)$).

Compactness cannot be dropped: the multiplication operator $(Mx)(t)=tx(t)$ on $L^2[0,1]$ is self-adjoint but not compact, with spectrum $[0,1]$ and no eigenvectors; the general self-adjoint spectral theorem is expressed through a projection-valued measure, $T=\int\lambda\,dE(\lambda)$.

Standard applications: positive operators ($\langle Tx,x\rangle\ge0$) have nonnegative spectrum and admit a square root $\sqrt T$; ordering the eigenvalues $|\lambda_1|\ge|\lambda_2|\ge\cdots$ gives $\|T\|=|\lambda_1|$, the standard tool for integral operators and Sturm–Liouville problems.

examples.problem: 设 $G(t,s)=\min(t,s)\bigl(1-\max(t,s)\bigr)$（即 $t\le s$ 时 $G(t,s)=t(1-s)$，$t>s$ 时 $G(t,s)=s(1-t)$），在 $L^2[0,1]$ 上定义 $(Kx)(t)=\int_0^1G(t,s)x(s)\,ds$。说明 $K$ 是紧自伴算子，并求全部特征值与特征向量。
examples.solution:
$G$ 对称且连续，故 $K$ 自伴（交换积分次序即得 $\langle Kx,y\rangle=\langle x,Ky\rangle$）；核连续保证 $K$ 紧（可用对 $G$ 的多项式逼近得到有限秩算子的一致逼近）。设 $u=Kx$：$G$ 是边值问题 $-u''=x$、$u(0)=u(1)=0$ 的格林函数（对 $t$ 求二阶偏导时，$G$ 在 $s=t$ 处的斜率跳跃为 $1$，产生 $\delta$ 源），于是 $u$ 满足 $-u''=x$、$u(0)=u(1)=0$。取 $u_k(t)=\sin(k\pi t)$：$-u_k''=(k\pi)^2u_k$，故
$$Ku_k=\frac{1}{(k\pi)^2}\,u_k,$$
即特征值 $\lambda_k=\frac{1}{(k\pi)^2}$、特征向量 $\sin(k\pi t)$。归一化后的 $\{\sqrt2\sin(k\pi t)\}$ 正是 $L^2[0,1]$ 的标准正交基，与谱定理完全一致：
$$\sigma(K)=\{0\}\cup\left\{\frac{1}{(k\pi)^2}:k\ge1\right\},$$
非零特征值以 $0$ 为唯一聚点，而 $0$ 不是特征值（若 $Ku=0$ 则 $u''=0$ 且 $u(0)=u(1)=0$，故 $u=0$）。

examples.problem: 用 $T=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$ 验证谱定理：写出特征向量的标准正交基，并核对 $\|T\|=\max_k|\lambda_k|$。
examples.solution: $T=T^*$ 自伴。特征多项式 $(\lambda-2)^2-1=(\lambda-3)(\lambda-1)$，特征值 $3,1$，对应单位特征向量 $e_1=\frac{1}{\sqrt2}(1,1)$、$e_2=\frac{1}{\sqrt2}(1,-1)$；二者正交，构成 $\mathbb R^2$ 的标准正交基，谱分解为 $T=3P_1+P_2$。由于 $T$ 对称，$\|T\|=3=\max\{3,1\}=\sup|\sigma(T)|$，与 $\|T\|=r(T)$ 一致。

expression.text: T = T*：⟨Tx,y⟩ = ⟨x,Ty⟩；紧自伴时 Tx = Σ λₖ⟨x,eₖ⟩eₖ，{eₖ} 为标准正交基，λₖ ∈ ℝ 且 λₖ→0
expression.note: 自伴算子的谱在实轴上且 $\|T\|=r(T)$；紧自伴算子可由标准正交特征基完全对角化。
expression.noteEn: A self-adjoint operator has real spectrum with $\|T\|=r(T)$; a compact self-adjoint operator is completely diagonalised by an orthonormal eigenbasis.

unbounded-operators.definition:
**无界算子**是定义在希尔伯特空间（或巴拿赫空间）$H$ 的线性子空间 $D(T)$ 上的线性映射 $T:D(T)\to H$，它不有界：不存在常数 $C$ 使 $\|Tx\|\le C\|x\|$ 对一切 $x\in D(T)$ 成立。有限维空间上每个线性算子都有界，因此无界算子只在无限维出现；它们的典型来源是微分：$L^2$ 中一个函数可以范数很小却剧烈振荡，微商把振荡放大，于是 $\|Tf\|/\|f\|$ 可以任意大。

一个自然的念头是「把定义域扩到全空间不就可以回避这些麻烦了吗？」**Hellinger–Toeplitz 定理**说不可以：处处定义（$D(T)=H$）的对称算子必定有界。证明只用闭图像定理与对称性：若 $x_n\to x$ 且 $Tx_n\to z$，则对每个 $y$ 有
$$\langle z,y\rangle=\lim\langle Tx_n,y\rangle=\lim\langle x_n,Ty\rangle=\langle x,Ty\rangle=\langle Tx,y\rangle,$$
故 $z=Tx$，图像闭，$T$ 有界。结论：**任何无界对称算子的定义域都是 $H$ 的真子空间**，通常取为稠密子空间。

定义域还决定「伴随」的含义。$T$ 的**伴随** $T^*$ 的定义域由有界性条件给出：
$$D(T^*)=\{y\in H:\exists C,\ |\langle Tx,y\rangle|\le C\|x\|\ \ \forall x\in D(T)\},$$
对这样的 $y$，$x\mapsto\langle Tx,y\rangle$ 可连续延拓到 $H$，再由 Riesz 表示定理唯一确定 $T^*y$。若 $T\subseteq T^*$（在 $D(T)$ 上二者一致），称 $T$ **对称**；若 $T=T^*$，称 $T$ **自伴**——这要求两个定义域完全相同，比对称强得多，而且微调定义域就能改变自伴性（例如区间上导数算子取不同的边界条件）。若对称算子 $T$ 的闭包 $\overline T$ 自伴，则称 $T$ **本质自伴**：它有唯一的自伴扩张，这正是量子力学中「该选哪个自伴扩张」问题的答案。
unbounded-operators.definitionEn:
An **unbounded operator** is a linear map $T:D(T)\to H$ defined on a linear subspace $D(T)$ of a Hilbert space (or Banach space) $H$ which is not bounded: no constant $C$ satisfies $\|Tx\|\le C\|x\|$ for all $x\in D(T)$. Every linear operator on a finite-dimensional space is bounded, so unbounded operators appear only in infinite dimensions; their typical source is differentiation, since a function in $L^2$ can have small norm while oscillating violently, and differentiation amplifies those oscillations without bound.

A natural hope is to enlarge the domain to all of $H$ and avoid the complications. The **Hellinger–Toeplitz theorem** rules this out: a symmetric operator defined everywhere ($D(T)=H$) is automatically bounded. The proof uses only the closed graph theorem and symmetry: if $x_n\to x$ and $Tx_n\to z$, then for every $y$,
$\langle z,y\rangle=\lim\langle Tx_n,y\rangle=\lim\langle x_n,Ty\rangle=\langle x,Ty\rangle=\langle Tx,y\rangle$,
so $z=Tx$; the graph is closed and $T$ is bounded. Consequently, **every unbounded symmetric operator has a proper domain** in $H$, usually taken dense.

The domain also governs what ``adjoint'' means. The **adjoint** $T^*$ has domain
$D(T^*)=\{y\in H:\exists C,\ |\langle Tx,y\rangle|\le C\|x\|\ \ \forall x\in D(T)\}$;
for such a $y$ the functional $x\mapsto\langle Tx,y\rangle$ extends continuously to $H$, and Riesz representation determines $T^*y$ uniquely. If $T\subseteq T^*$ (the two agree on $D(T)$), $T$ is called **symmetric**; if $T=T^*$, it is **self-adjoint** — note that this requires the two domains to coincide, which is much stronger than symmetry, and adjusting the domain (for instance boundary conditions for a derivative on an interval) can change self-adjointness. If a symmetric operator $T$ has a self-adjoint closure $\overline T$, then $T$ is called **essentially self-adjoint**: it has a unique self-adjoint extension, which is precisely the answer to the physicist's question of which self-adjoint extension to choose.

formulas.latex: T:D(T)\to H,\qquad D(T)\ \text{是}\ H\ \text{的真子空间（稠密性属通常约定）},\qquad \sup_{x\ne0}\frac{\|Tx\|}{\|x\|}=\infty
formulas.note: 无界算子的画像：定义域是稠密真子空间，且 $\|Tx\|/\|x\|$ 无上界。
formulas.noteEn: The picture of an unbounded operator: a dense proper domain, with $\|Tx\|/\|x\|$ unbounded.

formulas.note: 处处定义的对称算子必有界（闭图像定理）。因此无界对称算子（如动量算子）只能定义在真子空间上。
formulas.noteEn: An everywhere defined symmetric operator is bounded (closed graph theorem). Hence an unbounded symmetric operator such as the momentum operator can only have a proper domain.

formulas.latex: T\ \text{对称}:\ T\subseteq T^{*};\qquad T\ \text{自伴}:\ T=T^{*},\ \text{即}\ D(T)=D(T^{*})
formulas.note: 对称只是「图像包含」，自伴要求定义域完全相同；自伴必对称，反之不成立。
formulas.noteEn: Symmetry is a graph inclusion, while self-adjointness requires identical domains; self-adjoint implies symmetric, but not conversely.

formulas.latex: D(T^{*})=\{y\in H:\ \exists C,\ |\langle Tx,y\rangle|\le C\|x\|\ \ \forall x\in D(T)\}
formulas.note: 伴随算子的定义域：使 $x\mapsto\langle Tx,y\rangle$ 有界的那些 $y$，$T^*y$ 由 Riesz 表示定理确定。
formulas.noteEn: The domain of the adjoint consists of those $y$ for which $x\mapsto\langle Tx,y\rangle$ is bounded; then $T^*y$ is determined by the Riesz representation theorem.

formulas.note: 动量算子：定义域取索伯列夫空间 $H^1(\mathbb R)$（函数与弱导数都平方可和）时自伴，谱为全实轴且无特征值。
formulas.noteEn: The momentum operator: with domain the Sobolev space $H^1(\mathbb R)$ (function and weak derivative square-integrable) it is self-adjoint, with spectrum the whole real line and no eigenvalues.

properties: Hellinger–Toeplitz 定理：处处定义的对称算子必有界；因此无界对称算子（如动量算子）不可能定义在全空间上，其定义域必是稠密真子空间。
对称算子满足 $T\subseteq T^*$，而伴随算子总是闭的，故对称算子可闭；闭包 $\overline T$ 的伴随仍为 $T^*$。

自伴严格强于对称：要求 $D(T)=D(T^*)$。例如 $\frac{d}{dx}$ 在 $H^1(\mathbb R)$ 上只是斜对称（$D\subseteq-D^*$），而 $p=-i\frac{d}{dx}$（同一定义域）自伴；在有界区间上，$-i\frac{d}{dx}$ 由 $C_c^\infty(0,1)$ 出发有整族边界条件 $f(1)=e^{i\theta}f(0)$ 给出的自伴扩张。
无界自伴算子的例子：位置算子 $(Mx)(t)=tx(t)$，$D(M)=\{x\in L^2(\mathbb R):tx\in L^2(\mathbb R)\}$，自伴无界，$\sigma(M)=\mathbb R$ 且无特征值；动量算子 $p=-i\,d/dx$ 在 $H^1(\mathbb R)$ 上自伴无界，$\sigma(p)=\mathbb R$ 为连续谱。
本质自伴的对称算子有唯一自伴扩张；一般的对称算子可能没有或有多个自伴扩张（由亏指数分类）。有界自伴算子的谱定理可通过 Cayley 变换推广到无界自伴算子。
propertiesEn: Hellinger–Toeplitz: an everywhere defined symmetric operator is bounded; hence an unbounded symmetric operator such as the momentum operator cannot be defined on all of $H$ and must have a dense proper domain.
A symmetric operator satisfies $T\subseteq T^*$, and adjoints are always closed, so symmetric operators are closable; the adjoint of the closure $\overline T$ is again $T^*$.

Self-adjointness is strictly stronger than symmetry: it requires $D(T)=D(T^*)$. For example $\frac{d}{dx}$ on $H^1(\mathbb R)$ is only skew-symmetric ($D\subseteq-D^*$), whereas $p=-i\frac{d}{dx}$ on the same domain is self-adjoint; on a bounded interval $-i\frac{d}{dx}$ starting from $C_c^\infty(0,1)$ has a whole family of self-adjoint extensions given by boundary conditions $f(1)=e^{i\theta}f(0)$.

Examples of unbounded self-adjoint operators: the position operator $(Mx)(t)=tx(t)$ with $D(M)=\{x\in L^2(\mathbb R):tx\in L^2(\mathbb R)\}$, self-adjoint and unbounded with $\sigma(M)=\mathbb R$ and no eigenvalues; the momentum operator $p=-i\,d/dx$ on $H^1(\mathbb R)$, self-adjoint and unbounded with purely continuous spectrum $\mathbb R$.

An essentially self-adjoint symmetric operator has a unique self-adjoint extension; a general symmetric operator may have none or several, classified by deficiency indices. The spectral theorem for bounded self-adjoint operators extends to unbounded self-adjoint operators via the Cayley transform.

examples.problem: 证明位置算子 $(Mx)(t)=tx(t)$（定义在 $L^2(\mathbb R)$ 上，$D(M)=\{x:\int_{\mathbb R}t^2|x(t)|^2\,dt<\infty\}$）定义域稠密、无界且自伴。
examples.solution:
稠密性：$C_c(\mathbb R)$ 中的函数有界支撑，显然属于 $D(M)$。无界性：取 $x_n=\frac{1}{\sqrt n}\mathbf{1}_{(0,n)}$，则 $\|x_n\|=1$，而
$$\|Mx_n\|^2=\frac1n\int_0^nt^2\,dt=\frac{n^2}{3}\to\infty,$$
故无界。自伴性：对 $x,y\in D(M)$ 直接计算得 $\langle Mx,y\rangle=\int tx\bar y=\langle x,My\rangle$（积分绝对收敛），故 $M\subseteq M^*$。反之设 $y\in D(M^*)$：若 $y\notin D(M)$，令 $c_N=\|My\,\mathbf 1_{[-N,N]}\|$（随 $N$ 单调递增，由 $\|My\|=\infty$ 知 $c_N\to\infty$），取 $x_N=\frac{My\,\mathbf 1_{[-N,N]}}{c_N}$，则 $\|x_N\|=1$、$x_N\in D(M)$，且 $\langle Mx_N,y\rangle=c_N\to\infty$，与 $y\in D(M^*)$ 矛盾。故 $D(M^*)=D(M)$，$M$ 自伴。

examples.problem: 验证动量算子 $p=-i\frac{d}{dx}$、$D(p)=H^1(\mathbb R)$ 是无界对称算子，并说明它为什么不能处处定义。
examples.solution:
对 $f,g\in H^1(\mathbb R)$ 分部积分。$H^1$ 函数在 $\pm\infty$ 处趋于 $0$，边界项消失：
$$\langle pf,g\rangle=-i\int f'\bar g=i\int f\bar g'=\langle f,pg\rangle,$$
故 $p$ 对称（可以进一步证明 $D(p^*)=H^1$，即 $p$ 自伴）。无界性：取非零 $\varphi\in C_c^\infty(\mathbb R)$，令 $f_n(t)=e^{int}\varphi(t)$，则 $\|f_n\|=\|\varphi\|$ 不随 $n$ 变化，而
$$\|pf_n\|=\|n\varphi-i\varphi'\|\ge n\|\varphi\|-\|\varphi'\|\to\infty,$$
故 $p$ 无界。由 Hellinger–Toeplitz 定理，处处定义的对称算子必有界，所以 $p$ 的自伴性只能在真子空间 $H^1(\mathbb R)$ 上实现，定义域不能扩为整个 $L^2(\mathbb R)$。

expression.text: p = −i d/dx，D(p) = H¹(ℝ)，p = p*；M x(t) = t x(t)，D(M) = {x ∈ L²(ℝ) : t x ∈ L²(ℝ)}
expression.note: 自伴要求定义域相同；Hellinger–Toeplitz：处处定义的对称算子必有界。
expression.noteEn: Self-adjointness requires equal domains; Hellinger–Toeplitz: an everywhere defined symmetric operator is bounded.

weak-convergence.definition:
设 $X$ 是巴拿赫空间，$\{x_n\}\subset X$，$x\in X$。若对**每个** $f\in X^*$ 都有 $f(x_n)\to f(x)$，就说 $x_n$ **弱收敛**于 $x$，记作 $x_n\rightharpoonup x$。它的含义是让对偶空间中全体连续线性泛函一起当「检验员」：$X^*$ 越丰富，能看穿的细节越多，弱收敛就越接近范数收敛。最基本的比较是：**范数收敛必弱收敛**（每个 $f$ 都连续），**反之不成立**——$\ell^2$ 中的标准正交基满足 $e_n\rightharpoonup0$（对任意 $y\in\ell^2$ 有 $\langle e_n,y\rangle=y_n\to0$），但 $\|e_n\|=1$ 不趋于 $0$。（在希尔伯特空间中，补上范数条件即可反推：$x_n\to x$ 当且仅当 $x_n\rightharpoonup x$ 且 $\|x_n\|\to\|x\|$。）

弱收敛虽弱，却自带两条正则性。其一是**有界性**：弱收敛序列必有界。证法是把每个 $x_n$ 看作 $X^*$ 上的泛函 $f\mapsto f(x_n)$（这正是典范嵌入），它们逐点有界，由一致有界原理其范数有界。其二是**范数的弱下半连续性**：$\|x\|\le\liminf_{n\to\infty}\|x_n\|$，弱极限的范数只会更小。在希尔伯特空间里，Riesz 表示定理把弱收敛翻译成「对每个 $y$ 有 $\langle x_n,y\rangle\to\langle x,y\rangle$」。

弱收敛真正的好处是紧性。称 $X$ **自反**，如果典范嵌入 $\kappa(x)(f)=f(x)$ 把 $X$ 映满 $X^{**}$（即 $X^{**}=\kappa(X)$）。自反空间的核心红利是 **Eberlein–Šmulian 定理**：单位球弱紧，从而**自反空间中任何有界序列都有弱收敛子列**——这是无限维中替代「有界闭集紧」的标准结论。$L^p(1<p<\infty)$ 与希尔伯特空间都自反；$L^1$、$L^\infty$ 与 $C[a,b]$ 都不自反。一个容易混淆的对比：对偶空间 $X^*$ 的单位球总是弱*紧的（Banach–Alaoglu 定理），这只需以 $X$ 为检验员；而**单位球弱紧等价于 $X$ 自反**（Kakutani 定理）。$L^1$ 不自反的一个具体表现是：有界序列 $n\mathbf 1_{(0,1/n)}$ 没有任何弱收敛子列。
weak-convergence.definitionEn:
Let $X$ be a Banach space, $\{x_n\}\subset X$ and $x\in X$. We say that $x_n$ **converges weakly** to $x$, written $x_n\rightharpoonup x$, if $f(x_n)\to f(x)$ for **every** $f\in X^*$. The idea is that all continuous linear functionals act together as detectors: the richer $X^*$ is, the more detail they see, and the closer weak convergence comes to norm convergence. The basic comparison: **norm convergence implies weak convergence** (every $f$ is continuous), **but not conversely** — in $\ell^2$ the standard orthonormal basis satisfies $e_n\rightharpoonup0$ (for every $y\in\ell^2$, $\langle e_n,y\rangle=y_n\to0$) although $\|e_n\|=1$ does not tend to $0$. (In a Hilbert space one extra hypothesis reverses the implication: $x_n\to x$ iff $x_n\rightharpoonup x$ and $\|x_n\|\to\|x\|$.)

Weak convergence is weak, but it comes with two regularity properties for free. First, **boundedness**: a weakly convergent sequence is bounded. The proof views each $x_n$ as the functional $f\mapsto f(x_n)$ on $X^*$ (this is exactly the canonical embedding); the sequence is pointwise bounded, so the uniform boundedness principle bounds the norms. Second, **weak lower semicontinuity of the norm**: $\|x\|\le\liminf_{n\to\infty}\|x_n\|$, so a weak limit can only be smaller in norm. In a Hilbert space the Riesz representation theorem translates weak convergence into $\langle x_n,y\rangle\to\langle x,y\rangle$ for every $y$.

The real gain of weak convergence is compactness. A Banach space $X$ is **reflexive** if the canonical embedding $\kappa(x)(f)=f(x)$ maps $X$ onto $X^{**}$, i.e. $X^{**}=\kappa(X)$. The payoff is the **Eberlein–Šmulian theorem**: the unit ball is weakly compact, hence **every bounded sequence in a reflexive space has a weakly convergent subsequence** — the standard infinite-dimensional substitute for ``bounded closed sets are compact''. The spaces $L^p(1<p<\infty)$ and all Hilbert spaces are reflexive, whereas $L^1$, $L^\infty$ and $C[a,b]$ are not. One contrast is easily confused: the unit ball of a dual space $X^*$ is always weak-star compact (Banach–Alaoglu), which only uses testing against $X$; weak compactness of the unit ball, by contrast, is equivalent to reflexivity (Kakutani). A concrete sign that $L^1$ is not reflexive: the bounded sequence $n\mathbf 1_{(0,1/n)}$ has no weakly convergent subsequence.

formulas.latex: x_n\rightharpoonup x\iff f(x_n)\to f(x)\qquad\forall f\in X^{*}
formulas.note: 弱收敛的定义：与 $X^*$ 中每个连续线性泛函配对都收敛。$X^*$ 越丰富，弱收敛就越强。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of weak convergence: convergence when paired with every continuous linear functional in $X^*$. The richer $X^*$, the stronger weak convergence is.

formulas.latex: x_n\to x\ \Longrightarrow\ x_n\rightharpoonup x\qquad(\text{反之不成立})
formulas.note: 范数收敛必弱收敛，反之不然：$\ell^2$ 中 $e_n\rightharpoonup0$ 但 $\|e_n\|=1$ 不收敛到 $0$。方向不能写反。
formulas.noteEn: Norm convergence implies weak convergence, but not conversely: in $\ell^2$, $e_n\rightharpoonup0$ while $\|e_n\|=1$ does not tend to $0$. The direction must not be reversed.

formulas.note: 弱收敛序列有界（一致有界原理），且范数是弱下半连续的：弱极限的范数不超过范数的下极限。
formulas.noteEn: A weakly convergent sequence is bounded (uniform boundedness principle), and the norm is weakly lower semicontinuous: the limit has norm at most the lower limit of the norms.

formulas.latex: H\ \text{希尔伯特}:\quad x_n\rightharpoonup x\iff \langle x_n,y\rangle\to\langle x,y\rangle\ \forall y\in H;\qquad x_n\to x\iff x_n\rightharpoonup x\ \text{且}\ \|x_n\|\to\|x\|
formulas.note: 里斯表示定理把弱收敛写成内积收敛；此时「弱收敛 + 范数收敛到极限的范数」等价于范数收敛。
formulas.noteEn: Riesz representation rewrites weak convergence as convergence of all inner products; here weak convergence plus convergence of the norms to the norm of the limit is equivalent to norm convergence.

formulas.note: 自反空间中单位球弱紧，故有界序列必有弱收敛子列。$L^p(1<p<\infty)$、希尔伯特空间自反；$L^1$、$L^\infty$、$C[a,b]$ 不自反。
formulas.noteEn: In a reflexive space the unit ball is weakly compact, so every bounded sequence has a weakly convergent subsequence. $L^p(1<p<\infty)$ and Hilbert spaces are reflexive; $L^1$, $L^\infty$ and $C[a,b]$ are not.

properties: 弱极限唯一，线性运算保持弱收敛；范数收敛必弱收敛，反之不然（$\ell^2$ 中 $e_n\rightharpoonup0$ 而 $\|e_n\|=1$）。
弱收敛序列必有界（典范嵌入 + 一致有界原理），且范数弱下半连续：$\|x\|\le\liminf_{n}\|x_n\|$。
自反空间中单位球弱紧，有界序列必有弱收敛子列（Eberlein–Šmulian）；$L^p(1<p<\infty)$ 与希尔伯特空间自反，$L^1$、$L^\infty$、$C[a,b]$ 不自反。
希尔伯特空间中弱收敛等价于对每个 $y$ 有 $\langle x_n,y\rangle\to\langle x,y\rangle$（里斯表示定理）；弱收敛且 $\|x_n\|\to\|x\|$ 时即范数收敛。
紧算子把弱收敛升级为范数收敛：$x_n\rightharpoonup x$ 且 $T$ 紧 $\Rightarrow Tx_n\to Tx$；当 $X$ 自反时该性质反过来刻画紧性。
propertiesEn: Weak limits are unique and linear operations preserve weak convergence; norm convergence implies weak convergence but not conversely ($e_n\rightharpoonup0$ with $\|e_n\|=1$ in $\ell^2$).
A weakly convergent sequence is bounded (canonical embedding plus the uniform boundedness principle), and the norm is weakly lower semicontinuous: $\|x\|\le\liminf_{n}\|x_n\|$.

In a reflexive space the unit ball is weakly compact, so every bounded sequence has a weakly convergent subsequence (Eberlein–Šmulian); $L^p$, $1<p<\infty$, and Hilbert spaces are reflexive, while $L^1$, $L^\infty$ and $C[a,b]$ are not.

In a Hilbert space weak convergence is equivalent to $\langle x_n,y\rangle\to\langle x,y\rangle$ for every $y$ (Riesz representation); weak convergence together with $\|x_n\|\to\|x\|$ gives norm convergence.
A compact operator turns weak convergence into norm convergence: $x_n\rightharpoonup x$ with $T$ compact implies $Tx_n\to Tx$; when $X$ is reflexive this property characterises compactness.

examples.problem: 在 $\ell^2$ 中证明 $e_n\rightharpoonup0$ 但不范数收敛，并验证 $\|0\|\le\liminf_n\|e_n\|$。
examples.solution:
任取 $y=(y_k)\in\ell^2$。由 $\sum_k|y_k|^2<\infty$ 得 $y_n\to0$，故
$$\langle e_n,y\rangle=y_n\to0=\langle0,y\rangle,$$
即 $e_n\rightharpoonup0$。但 $\|e_n-0\|=1\not\to0$，所以弱收敛确实严格弱于范数收敛，两个方向不能互换。同时 $\|0\|=0\le1=\liminf_n\|e_n\|$，说明范数只是弱下半连续的，弱极限的范数可以严格更小。

$\|f_n\|_1=1$，是有界序列。假设某个子列 $f_{n_k}\rightharpoonup f$（$f\in L^1$），则对每个 $g\in L^\infty$ 有 $\int_0^1f_{n_k}g\to\int_0^1fg$。特别取 $g\in C[0,1]$：
$$\int_0^1f_{n_k}g=n_k\int_0^{1/n_k}g(t)\,dt\to g(0)\qquad(\text{积分平均}),$$
于是必须有 $\int_0^1fg=g(0)$ 对一切连续 $g$ 成立。取 $g_m(t)=(1-t)^m$：左边由控制收敛定理趋于 $0$，而右边 $g_m(0)=1$，矛盾。（等价地说，泛函 $g\mapsto g(0)$ 不能由任何 $L^1$ 函数表示。）故该有界序列没有弱收敛子列；若 $L^1$ 自反，Eberlein–Šmulian 定理保证有界序列必有弱收敛子列，矛盾——所以 $L^1[0,1]$ 不自反。

expression.text: xₙ ⇀ x ⟺ 对每个 f∈X* 有 f(xₙ)→f(x)；X 自反 ⟺ 典范嵌入满射，κ(x)(f)=f(x)
expression.note: 范数收敛 ⇒ 弱收敛；自反空间中有界序列必有弱收敛子列。
expression.noteEn: Norm convergence implies weak convergence; every bounded sequence in a reflexive space has a weakly convergent subsequence.

fredholm-alternative.definition:
设 $X$ 是巴拿赫空间，$T\in B(X)$ 紧，$\lambda\ne0$，考察方程 $(\lambda I-T)x=y$（$y\in X$）。**弗雷德霍姆二择一定理**断言：下列两种情形必居其一。

**情形一（唯一可解）**：对每个 $y\in X$，方程有唯一解 $x=(\lambda I-T)^{-1}y$。此时 $\lambda\in\rho(T)$，$\lambda I-T$ 在 $B(X)$ 中可逆且逆有界。

**情形二（齐次方程有非零解）**：$(\lambda I-T)x=0$ 有非零解，即 $\lambda$ 是 $T$ 的特征值，且特征子空间有限维。此时 $\lambda I-T$ 的值域是真子空间：非齐次方程**要么无解，要么有无穷多个解**——只要有一个解 $x_0$，$x_0+\ker(\lambda I-T)$ 全是解。哪些 $y$ 有解由正交条件给出：$y$ 可解当且仅当 $y$ 与伴随方程 $(\lambda I-T^*)f=0$ 的每个解正交，即 $f(y)=0$ 对一切 $f\in\ker(\lambda I-T^*)$ 成立（等价写法 $y\in\operatorname{ran}(\lambda I-T)$）。当 $T$ 自伴时条件化简为 $y\perp\ker(\lambda I-T)$。

与有限维对照，这就是「$A$ 可逆则 $Ax=y$ 唯一可解；$A$ 奇异则 $Ax=y$ 无解或有无穷多解」的无限维版本：紧性使 $\lambda I-T$ 表现得像有限维矩阵，谱里因此没有「怪东西」。换言之，它是谱论形式的陈述：**紧算子的每个非零谱点都是特征值**，即 $\lambda\in\sigma(T)$、$\lambda\ne0$ 时必有 $\lambda\in\sigma_p(T)$，并且 $\dim\ker(\lambda I-T)=\dim\ker(\lambda I-T^*)<\infty$、值域闭（弗雷德霍姆算子的指标为零）。最后必须强调 $\lambda=0$ 被排除在二择一之外：无限维空间中紧算子总有 $0\in\sigma(T)$（若 $T$ 可逆，则 $I=T^{-1}T$ 作为紧算子之积也紧，迫使 $\dim X<\infty$），而 $0$ 可能只是连续谱——对角算子 $\operatorname{diag}(1/n)$ 满足 $0\in\sigma(T)\setminus\sigma_p(T)$，在 $\lambda=0$ 处二择一失效。
fredholm-alternative.definitionEn:
Let $X$ be a Banach space, let $T\in B(X)$ be compact and let $\lambda\ne0$. Consider the equation $(\lambda I-T)x=y$ with $y\in X$. **The Fredholm alternative** states that exactly one of the following two alternatives holds.

**First alternative (unique solvability).** For every $y\in X$ the equation has a unique solution $x=(\lambda I-T)^{-1}y$; equivalently $\lambda\in\rho(T)$, so $\lambda I-T$ is invertible in $B(X)$ with bounded inverse.

**Second alternative (the homogeneous equation has a nonzero solution).** $(\lambda I-T)x=0$ has a nonzero solution, i.e. $\lambda$ is an eigenvalue of $T$ with finite-dimensional eigenspace. Then the range of $\lambda I-T$ is a proper subspace and the inhomogeneous equation has **either no solution or infinitely many**: once one solution $x_0$ exists, so do all of $x_0+\ker(\lambda I-T)$. Which $y$ are solvable is decided by an orthogonality condition: $y$ lies in $\operatorname{ran}(\lambda I-T)$ iff $f(y)=0$ for every $f\in\ker(\lambda I-T^*)$, i.e. $y$ is orthogonal to every solution of the adjoint homogeneous equation. If $T$ is self-adjoint, the condition simply reads $y\perp\ker(\lambda I-T)$.

Compared with finite-dimensional linear algebra, this is the infinite-dimensional version of ``$A$ invertible means $Ax=y$ is uniquely solvable, while a singular $A$ gives either no solution or infinitely many.'' Compactness makes $\lambda I-T$ behave like a matrix, and the spectrum contains nothing pathological. Equivalently, the theorem is a statement about spectra: **every nonzero spectral point of a compact operator is an eigenvalue**, and indeed for $\lambda\in\sigma(T)$, $\lambda\ne0$, one has $\dim\ker(\lambda I-T)=\dim\ker(\lambda I-T^*)<\infty$ with closed range (the Fredholm operator $\lambda I-T$ has index zero). Finally, $\lambda=0$ must be excluded: a compact operator on an infinite-dimensional space always has $0\in\sigma(T)$ (if $T$ were invertible, $I=T^{-1}T$ would be compact, forcing $\dim X<\infty$), yet $0$ may merely be continuous spectrum — for $\operatorname{diag}(1/n)$ one has $0\in\sigma(T)\setminus\sigma_p(T)$, and at $\lambda=0$ the alternative genuinely fails.

formulas.noteEn: The two branches: either unique solvability for every $y$ ($\lambda\in\rho(T)$), or the homogeneous equation has a nonzero solution ($\lambda$ is an eigenvalue).

formulas.noteEn: For compact $T$ and $\lambda\ne0$: kernel and cokernel are finite-dimensional of equal dimension (index zero), and the range is closed.

properties: 两个分支互斥且穷尽：要么 $\lambda\in\rho(T)$（对每个 $y$ 唯一可解），要么 $\lambda\in\sigma_p(T)$（非齐次方程无解或有无穷多解，解集是特解加有限维核）。
对紧算子 $T$ 与 $\lambda\ne0$：$\lambda\in\sigma(T)\iff\lambda\in\sigma_p(T)$；非零谱点全是特征值，对应特征子空间有限维、值域闭。
可解性判据（正交条件）：$(\lambda I-T)x=y$ 有解当且仅当 $y\perp\ker(\lambda I-T^*)$；$T$ 自伴时即 $y\perp\ker(\lambda I-T)$。
$\dim\ker(\lambda I-T)=\dim\ker(\lambda I-T^*)$（余核维数等于核维数，指标为零），这正是 $\lambda I-T$ 作为弗雷德霍姆算子的性质。
$0$ 的地位特殊：无限维空间中紧算子必有 $0\in\sigma(T)$，而 $0$ 可能不是特征值（如 $\operatorname{diag}(1/n)$），故定理必须假设 $\lambda\ne0$；非零特征值至多可数，且只能以 $0$ 为聚点。
propertiesEn: The two alternatives are mutually exclusive and exhaustive: either $\lambda\in\rho(T)$ (unique solvability for every $y$), or $\lambda\in\sigma_p(T)$ (no solution or infinitely many — a particular solution plus the finite-dimensional kernel).
For compact $T$ and $\lambda\ne0$: $\lambda\in\sigma(T)$ iff $\lambda\in\sigma_p(T)$; every nonzero spectral point is an eigenvalue, with finite-dimensional eigenspace and closed range.
Solvability criterion (orthogonality): $(\lambda I-T)x=y$ has a solution iff $y\perp\ker(\lambda I-T^*)$; when $T$ is self-adjoint this reads $y\perp\ker(\lambda I-T)$.
$\dim\ker(\lambda I-T)=\dim\ker(\lambda I-T^*)$ — the cokernel has the same finite dimension as the kernel (index zero), the defining property of the Fredholm operator $\lambda I-T$.

The point $0$ is special: a compact operator on an infinite-dimensional space always has $0\in\sigma(T)$, and $0$ may fail to be an eigenvalue (e.g. $\operatorname{diag}(1/n)$), which is why the theorem assumes $\lambda\ne0$; the nonzero eigenvalues are at most countable and can accumulate only at $0$.
